parameters.text:
=Extract the following information from this supplier email:

Email: {{ $("Check Gmail Every 5 Minutes").item.json.text }}

Extract and return ONLY a JSON object with these fields:
- pricePerUnit: number (extract the unit price)
- deliveryDate: string (ISO date format if mentioned)
- moq: number (minimum order quantity)
- paymentTerms: string (e.g., "Net 30", "50% upfront")
- contactDetails: string (phone or additional contact info)

If any field is not mentioned, use null. Return ONLY valid JSON, no other text.

options.systemMessage: You are a data extraction assistant. Extract structured information from emails and return only valid JSON.
